dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: (<color=#FFCC33FF>Nefer</color> looks like she has something to say...)

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Any special fruit in stock today?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: ...I'll have to take a look. What kind of fr{RUBY#[D]intelligence}uit were you hoping to ea{RUBY#[S]purchase}t, Lady Nefer?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: Oh, can your suppliers get you anything I'd like?

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Just say the word, and I'll check with the lea{RUBY#[S]Director}der of the caravan.

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'm looking to purchase a rather large quantity of fr{RUBY#[D]intelligence}uit, so if possible, I'd very much like to meet this lea{RUBY#[D]Director}der in person.

dialogues.speaker: Cairuo
dialogues.text: Ah, well, that would be a decision for the lea{RUBY#[S]Director}der to make. You know our way of doing things, don't you?

dialogues.speaker: Nefer
dialogues.text: I'm more than happy to wait, if you wouldn't mind passing on my invitation, Miss Cairuo.
